triplets.subject: As These Strategies Aim To
triplets.evidence_span:
As these strategies aim to reduce hallucinations, they also draw attention to

the limits of AI’s capacity for self-generated knowledge and raise the possibility that true human-like

intelligence may require more than just fine-tuning responses to align with data – it may demand an internal

comprehension that current models lack.

triplets.subject: Regulating These Parameters To
triplets.evidence_span:
By tightly regulating these parameters to reduce randomness, AI systems become

more predictable and factual, but at the cost of creativity and human-like behaviors.
